job.job_title: Python Fullstack Agentic AI Engineer - Mumbai Onsite
job.job_description:
About the Role


Fluid AI is looking for a Python Fullstack Agentic AI Engineer to work onsite at NABARDs Mumbai office. This is a client-facing role where you will be responsible for managing and enhancing Fluid AIs Agentic AI Platform deployed at the customer location.


Important: This role is based primarily from the NABARD office in Mumbai. Candidates should be comfortable working from a public sector enterprise environment and collaborating closely with customer stakeholders on a daily basis.




Responsibilities

Manage and support Fluid AIs Agentic AI Platform deployed at NABARD.
Build and enhance AI-powered workflows, agents, and enterprise use cases.
Develop backend services and APIs using Python.
Build and modify frontend applications using React/Next.js.
Integrate with enterprise systems, databases, APIs, and authentication platforms.
Gather requirements from business and technical teams and translate them into working solutions.
Troubleshoot production issues and support platform enhancements.



Required Skills

25 years of software development experience.
Strong Python development skills.
Experience with React and/or Next.js.
Experience building and consuming REST APIs.
Working knowledge of SQL/NoSQL databases.
Comfortable working directly with customers and stakeholders.



Good to Have

Experience with FastAPI.
Exposure to Generative AI, RAG, LLMs, LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, or Agentic AI frameworks.
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Linux, or cloud platforms.
Experience working on banking, government, or enterprise software projects.



Experience Compensation
2–3 Years 6–10 LPA
3–5 Years 10–16 LPA

If you enjoy solving real-world business problems, working directly with customers, and building production-grade AI applications, we’d love to hear from you.
